name: spout2
description: Spout is a video frame sharing system for Microsoft Windows, which allows applications to share OpenGL textures in a similar way to Syphon for the Mac.

This overlay pins the same source as the registry port (baseline 04a9d8e5) but keeps the Spout DLLs on static library triplets. OpenSpace builds against the x64-windows-static-md triplet (Ghoul's glbinding overlay port is static-only), yet SGCT links Spout2::SpoutLibrary, which is a SHARED imported target. The registry port deletes bin/ and debug/bin/ whenever VCPKG_LIBRARY_LINKAGE is static, which leaves the exported SHARED targets pointing at files that no longer exist and makes find_package(Spout2) fail. Spout is a runtime DLL sharing mechanism, so the DLL has to be present and shipped regardless of triplet.

dx.description: A sub-set of the Spout SDK for applications using DirectX rather than OpenGL.
